symptom: The reviewed Remotion scaffold used startFrom on dialogue without a paired picture offset, and its caption manifest assigned 140 delivery frames at 30fps (4.6667s) while the native video had 120 used frames at 24fps (5.0s). The review identified a blocking integration risk and endpoint mismatch; no affected completed export was observed.
verification: Independent audit P0-01 established the paired-AV requirement from source review. S01_A's 5-second editorial mapping correctly equates 120 native frames at 24fps to 150 delivery frames at 30fps, but the full-timeline composition still requires a rendered export and audible lip/caption review.
limitations: Source-level risk is confirmed, not an observed final-export desynchronization. Record any validated scoped shot preview separately and keep full-film AV resolution open.
root_cause: Audio silence was trimmed in the compositor after H3 generation rather than before; delivery 30fps frames were calculated without paired mathematical mapping to native 24fps video.
fix_or_workaround: Trim exact WAV silence ONCE before H3 motion generation. Bind native FPS (24), used native frames, picture offset, delivery FPS (30), and carry endpoint in a unified manifest. Continuous shots use exact last USED native frame.
prevention: Never trim audio in finishing without paired video offset; perform all silence trimming upstream before H3.
